newsitem.title: USA: Horsehead Industries unit sued by B.U.S. unit.
newsitem.headline: Horsehead Industries unit sued by B.U.S. unit.

text.p: Two lawsuits have been filed against a Horsehead Industries Inc unit by a unit of B.U.S. Bersilius Uwelt-Service AG and by its chief executive, both seeking an order allowing them access to Horsehead's books and records.

In information papers filed Friday in the Delaware Chancery Court, the subsidiary, B.U.S. Environmental Services Inc, said it owned 13.4 million shares or 42 percent of Horsehead Resource Development Co Inc's outstanding shares of common stock.
B.U.S. chief executive Gunter Okon said in his lawsuit that he is also a Horsehead director.

Last year Horsehead Resource offered to repurchase 4.6 million of its shares, including 2.9 million from B.U.S. Environmental, in order to take the company private. At the time, Horsehead was traded on NASDAQ.

Horsehead Resource recovers inorganic hazardous waste primarily from steelmaking in electric arc furnaces. The New York-based parent company manufactures zinc metal products through its Zinc Corp of America division.
B.U.S. of Duisburg, Germany is an industrial materials recycler.
An attorney for B.U.S. was not available for comment. Calls to Horsehead were not returned.
No other information about the lawsuit is available from the court at this time. The Chancery Court does not release lawsuits until defendants have been served.
